review_notes: The children are well looked after is natural: well precedes looked; preserve this key rather than applying the old false adverb rule.
Put off means postpone, not cancel; source02 preserves until Friday.
Bring up means raise a child; source03 preserves grandparents as explicit agent.
Turn down/request and deal with/complaint retain needed particle/preposition; polite/quick adverbs have finite required exercise position, not a global grammar rule.

review_notes: All first five active answers are topic-correct: type 4 is the compose-token interaction, not a requirement for passive voice.
Happen/arrive/sleep/die are ordinary intransitive senses here; belongs to is the stated possession relation. No mass lexical ban is inferred from these examples.
Child/baby distinction: Ukrainian дитина does not require any age assertion; baby is the supplied lexical choice, not an alternate tense/voice test.
A permitted passive remains in source09, but there is no pedagogical need to modify the first-five matcher order or create new questions merely to force a passive answer.
